description: Find the calls, forms and messages a business misses or answers too slowly, then set up the fix, covering missed-call text-back, after-hours handling, a follow-up cadence for open quotes, and one named owner for every callback. Works from a call log export and a spreadsheet; the phone system's own features, Zapier or Composio automate it if wanted. Use when leads go cold, calls go to voicemail, after-hours calls are lost, quotes are sent and never chased, or ads bring calls that don't turn into jobs.
